literal: Possible place all action good indeed; when not possible, succeeds way having considered act.
translation: Whenever possible, it is best to act directly. When that is not possible, one should consider the avenues that will succeed and act accordingly.
modern: இயலும் இடங்களில் எல்லாம் செயலை நேரடியாக முடிப்பது நல்லது. அப்படி இயலாத போது, அச்செயல் நிறைவேறும் வழியை ஆராய்ந்து செய்ய வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet advises on the flexibility required in executing a task. The opening phrase (where the first word is a common typographical variant or error for 'ollum') suggests that direct action is the best approach wherever circumstances permit. However, 'ollaakkaal' (when not possible) acknowledges that obstacles will inevitably arise. In such cases, rather than forcing the issue, one must find 'sellum vaay' (the way that works) and adapt their strategy to ensure the action is successfully completed.
